[[File:Khar.jpg|250px|right|thumb|Naga Sadow's fortress on Khar Shian]]
'''Naga Sadow's fortress''' was a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] maintained by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Khar Shian]], which was hidden from the rest of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and served as his base of operations. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Gav Daragon]] was imprisoned in this fortress.<ref name="Golden Age 4" />

Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="7.9 Date">{{TOR_updates|7.9}}</ref> [[Darth Jadus]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] built a devastating machine capable of imposing awareness of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] on billions of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] within the fortress. The fortress was later [[Battle of Khar Shian|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Eternal Alliance]], and the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
